basis: Inherited sensory and autonomic peripheral neuropathy; ulcers and skeletal complications are not established across most subtypes.
Acute myeloid malignancy involving blood and bone marrow; monosomy 5 does not establish additional organ involvement.
Developmental impairment and brain abnormalities define the disorder; cardiac abnormalities are less frequent without evidence meeting the threshold.
Endocardial thickening causes cardiomyopathy; supplied syndromic endocrine and neurologic annotations are not general features of isolated fibroelastosis.
Umbrella for diseases of the epidermis; extracutaneous manifestations do not apply across the group.
Obstruction affects the bladder outlet and urinary flow; bladder and urethra belong to the renal axis.
Leukoencephalopathy, hypogammaglobulinemia and colitis define the syndrome; arthritis is also a defining feature, placed in involved because of the primary cap.
PKHD1-associated cystic kidney disease; hepatic fibrosis occurs in 13/16. Hypertension in 12/16 is a separately diagnosed secondary condition.
Autoimmune hypercoagulability with arterial or venous thrombosis as a major diagnostic manifestation; obstetric manifestations have no organ axis.
Cardiac, cutaneous and developmental abnormalities define CFC; skeletal involvement includes pectus excavatum in 3/3 and scoliosis in 2/3.
HCN1-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; the supplied metabolic ancestor does not establish a metabolic disorder.
Anemia 3/3 and leukopenia 2/3; cholangitis 3/3; otosclerosis and conductive hearing loss 2/2. Cap prioritizes these over cutaneous warts; infection sites alone excluded.
Cerebellar hypoplasia, ataxia and intellectual disability define disease; frequent strabismus and muscle atrophy do not establish direct eye or muscle pathology.
Fibroblastic sarcoma arising in connective soft tissue; no additional organ origin or common direct involvement is specified.
Herpes simplex infection of vulva and vagina; reproductive anatomy has no dedicated axis.
Immunodeficiency defined by persistent CD4-positive lymphocytopenia; opportunistic infections are separate diseases.
Ceramide synthesis disorder causing progressive epilepsy and neurodegeneration; nystagmus alone does not establish direct ocular damage.
Viral infection directly inflames the stomach.
Exfoliation-associated glaucoma causes ocular pressure-related optic nerve damage.
Isolated inherited vertical nystagmus is an ocular motor disorder; no broader neurologic disease is established.
Neonatal blood disorder defined by reduced hemoglobin; other organs are not directly affected by the defining disease process.
Familial cardiac lipidosis is a metabolic cardiomyopathy; microcephaly has no frequency sufficient to support additional neurologic involvement.
Defective alpha-dystroglycan glycosylation causes muscular dystrophy; brain and eye abnormalities characterize severe subtypes rather than the entire umbrella.
Transient congenital thyroid hormone deficiency with goiter; delayed ossification and neonatal symptoms do not establish lasting skeletal or neurologic damage.
Bone-forming neoplasm encompassing osteoma, osteoblastoma and osteosarcoma.
